about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a front-end developer with an unwavering passion for creating modern, functional, and intuitive interfaces. Focused on user experience, I dedicate myself to transforming ideas into impactful, accessible visual solutions aligned with the best market practices. My motivation is to create digital experiences that connect people and technology efficiently. Additionally, I am always seeking improvement, learning new techniques, and keeping up with the latest web development trends, ensuring modern and innovative projects.

projects.title: Projects

efood.text: eFood is an online store web application that allows users to explore restaurants and their dishes. With an interactive interface, users can sign up, log in, add dishes to their cart, and view details. Developed with React, Redux, and Node.js, the application uses PostgreSQL to store data securely and persistently. Thanks to database synchronization, the cart can be accessed across different devices, ensuring a seamless and integrated shopping experience.

contactList.text: The Contact List is an intuitive and functional web application developed to ease the management of personal or professional contacts. With it, you can register, view, edit, and delete contacts, storing essential information such as name, email, and phone number. The user-friendly interface makes the experience simple and efficient, allowing you to organize your contacts quickly and practically.

codeConnect.text: Code-Connect is an application developed with Next.js to display posts about programming as part of an Alura course. The project uses PostgreSQL and Prisma for data persistence, Docker for database containerization, and CSS Modules for modular styling. It offers features such as post navigation, likes, comments, search, and filtering.

todoList.text: This is a To-do List project developed in React, created using create-react-app. The goal of this project is to manage tasks, allowing users to create, edit, remove, and filter tasks based on different criteria.

imcCalculator.text: This project is a simple Body Mass Index (BMI) calculator application, developed to help determine the user's weight category based on their height and weight.

disneyClone.text: Experience an immersive recreation of the Disney Plus interface, with features simulating the original navigation experience. This project highlights the integration of navigation, interactivity with JavaScript, and the use of modern front-end technologies.

quiz.text: Interactive Quiz developed for the challenge promoted by Alura's Dev Immersion in partnership with Google Gemini. The project is a dynamic quiz where players can choose categories, answer questions, and check the score at the end.

filmeflix.text: An interactive and visually appealing landing page displaying Spider-Man movies, categorized by actor. It stands out for its creative design and listing and filtering functionalities.

techbooks.text: TechBooks features an intuitive and responsive interface, where users can browse product categories such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, and PCs. The platform includes a dynamic and adaptable menu that makes it easier to search for specific products.
